name: Disaar Skin Protective 60+ Whitening Sunscreen Lotion 50g
description:
Disaar Skin Protective 60+ Whitening Sunscreen Lotion 50g | Made in China

Protect, hydrate, and brighten your skin with Disaar Skin Protective 60+ Whitening Sunscreen Lotion. This lightweight, fast-absorbing formula offers high SPF 60 protection, shields your skin from harmful UV rays, and helps prevent signs of aging while keeping your skin soft and moisturized.

Key Features:

High Sun Protection: SPF 60 blocks UVA and UVB rays to prevent sunburn and skin aging

Easy Absorption: Lightweight, natural texture that absorbs quickly without clogging pores

Skin Type: Suitable for all skin types

Enhanced Defense: Plant extracts and antioxidants strengthen the skin, improve elasticity, and reduce fine lines

Hydration: Moisturizing molecules replenish and maintain skin softness

Net Weight: 50g

Shelf Life: 3 years

Made in China

Keep your skin protected, hydrated, and youthful every day with Disaar Skin Protective 60+ Whitening Sunscreen Lotion.
